notes.title: 1.3 and Mac OS itch Release
notes.notes:
We've released the 1.3 update which brings in a 50% file size reduction for Dust and Air. We've also released a Mac OS version for this update. 

Unfortunately, the Mac OS version is only available on itch.io at this time as we still have issues with Apple's notarization process. 

Mac users can go here to get it: https://brokenhammergames.itch.io/all-is-fair-in-dust-and-air

We're also putting Dust and Air on sale for this week to celebrate the release! 50% file size reduction and 50% off sale!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 + Content Drop
notes.notes:
Final build of 2021 is here and because the glory of the Guns of Icarus v1.1 Squid can never be surpassed, we're jumping ahead to 1.2! (Well, more work went into it than anticipated)

Included is five short side stories that you can unlock while playing! There is also a new cheat page that you can unlock by finishing the story which will allow you to skip ahead between days of the story for future playthroughs. Why we didn't add that sooner? Blame the office cat!

Patch Notes: 

1.2
-Audio and video files converted in preparation for Android port
-New extended scene side stories added to the gallery section
-Fixes to routing where point allocation did not have proper values (All heroine routes should
give proper alternate paths based on earlier choices)
-Added cheat page at start of New Game for those who have finished the story (Ability to jump
directly to Day 1, 2, or 3).
-Minor spelling and grammar fixes

notes.title: Itch Release Weekend Sale
notes.notes:
Dust and Air is going DRM free on itch! To celebrate this release we're running a special 10% off weekend launch sale on both platforms!

You can find our itch page @ https://brokenhammergames.itch.io/all-is-fair-in-dust-and-air

notes.title: Final Patch of Early Access
notes.notes:
After a little delay, here it is! The final release of Early Access!

Patch update will include the last portion of story which closes out the Cathedral Story Arc. It is a minor content drop which will signify the conclusion of our Early Access adventure. 

If all goes well, we'll be exiting Early Access a week after this release.

Thank you again for joining us on this journey!

notes.title: Early Access Patch 3.0 Is Here!
notes.notes:
It's Here! The Early Access 3.0 content drop! 

With this patch we officially finish the story centered around the city of Cathedral and get ready to release our final update of Early Access that will begin the nation story arcs.

The 3.0 Changelog:

-Includes all content for the third and fourth day of the Cathedral arc story
-Conversion to Tyrano 2.0 engine
-Fullscreen bug resolved. Now functions in Windows 10
-Free window resize option now functional
-Gramps scenes given blur effect and better pop ups
-Various other fixes and tweaks. Some spelling and grammar corrections.
